text:
sqlpipe is a streaming export tool. It moves table data from Postgres to S3. The system has three processes that run at the same time.

The reader process connects to Postgres and streams rows from the source table. It groups rows into batches and sends each batch to the converter.

The converter takes each batch and builds a Parquet row group. It collects row groups into Parquet files that are ready for upload.

The uploader writes each Parquet file to S3 as a multipart object. It splits each file into parts and uploads each part in order. If an upload fails, the uploader retries the failed part.

The reader, converter, and uploader form a pipeline. Each process passes work to the next process. The full table does not load into memory on one host.
